The '''Sith Sanctum''' was the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] headquarters located on [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]]. The Sith Sanctum had many points of interests, including [[Darth Thanaton's private library]] and [[Darth Thanaton's meditation chamber|meditation chamber]].

==History==
The Sith Sanctum is as old as the Imperial Citadel itself. The [[Tenebrae|Sith Emperor]] made the Sith Sanctum his home and only a few Sith were allowed to enter his chambers.
